SEARCH
Package edu.kit.datamanager.takita.mainpage.search

Class SearchService

java.lang.Object
edu.kit.datamanager.takita.mainpage.search.SearchService
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISearchService
@SessionScope @Service public class SearchService extends Object implements ISearchService
SearchService contains all business logic to search the index provided by Spring.Data.
